name: blazor-apexgrid-e2e
description: Headless browser smoke test for the Blazor-ApexGrid sample. Guards against interop-only regressions (a grid that builds and serializes cleanly but fails to register, render, or wire up its web component in the browser) whenever the bundled apex-grid core is refreshed. enterprise.mjs does the same for Blazor-ApexGrid-Enterprise and checks that a page with both packages holds one apex-grid core.
